logp.method_description: By following the published protocol, the log Po/w of these complexes was calculated using the shake flask method. We used an orbital shaker to mix a known quantity of each compound with water (pre-saturated with n-octanol) for 48 hours. The solution was centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes in order to separate its phases. Following the bilayer separation, UV-Vis spectroscopic investigation was carried out and with the help of the OD of the complexes in water and octanol, we were able to determine the partition coefficient values (log Po/w).
